deviations: SEAM DECISION: AppHeader is fully presentational (prop-drilled), NOT hook-calling. All branded-only hooks (getPublicFleet via useFleetHeader, useHubConnectionState, useNotificationSound) are called in AppLayout and passed down as props. Rationale: calling them conditionally on `unbranded` inside AppHeader would violate rules-of-hooks and crash when WI-7 mounts it unbranded. 'getPublicFleet gated off when unbranded' is satisfied by intent: WI-7 simply does not pass connection/isMuted/onToggleMute and never mounts useFleetHeader. This also makes AppHeader.test.tsx trivial (no QueryClientProvider, no hook mocks).

unbranded brand text is a caller-supplied prop (`brand={{ name, colorHex }}`), NOT hardcoded 'Carfleet · Správa systému'. WI-7 passes its own admin brand + ink dot (colorHex handling: unbranded forces the ink dot regardless of colorHex). This keeps admin i18n owned by WI-7 and avoids re-opening AppHeader surgically.

Added a small shared-ish app hook web/src/app/useFleetHeader.ts (reuses queryKey ['public','fleet'] + 5min staleTime) instead of importing the customer-feature useFleetBranding hook (task forbids cross-feature import).
